schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: F1 (Content Factory)
definition: Eleventh-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Focus areas: administrative paperwork verbs, time/preposition calques, polite service-register repairs, relative-clause resumptive pronouns, question word order, and Vietnamese adjective false friends.
dedupedAgainst: F1 local check against live VIETLISH_CORPUS (986 entries on origin/main after Stage-2 2A/2B) plus pending waves 1-10, case-insensitive vietlish matching.

entries.sourcePattern: sau 2 ngày nữa -> after plus more is a Vietnamese time calque
entries.context: The package will arrive after 2 days more.

entries.sourcePattern: từ giờ đến thứ Sáu -> from now to is a direct calque

entries.sourcePattern: vào thứ Hai tới -> unnecessary article/preposition
entries.context: We can meet in the next Monday.

entries.vietlish: at the end of this month later
entries.natural: at the end of this month
entries.sourcePattern: cuối tháng này sau -> later is redundant
entries.context: I will pay at the end of this month later.

entries.vietlish: until next week I will send it
entries.natural: I will send it by next week
entries.sourcePattern: đến tuần sau tôi sẽ gửi -> until/by contrast
entries.context: Until next week I will send it.

entries.sourcePattern: trước hai tiếng -> before used without reference point
entries.context: Please come before two hours.

entries.sourcePattern: trễ năm phút -> adjective placement differs
entries.context: I was late five minutes today.

entries.vietlish: from yesterday until now I wait
entries.natural: I have been waiting since yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: từ hôm qua đến giờ -> present perfect progressive needed
entries.context: From yesterday until now I wait for the reply.

entries.sourcePattern: mỗi hai ngày -> plural day after number
entries.context: I water the plant every two day.

entries.sourcePattern: một lần mỗi hai tuần -> natural frequency phrase
entries.context: We meet one time per two weeks.

entries.sourcePattern: sớm nhất có thể -> wordy formal calque
entries.context: Please reply at the soonest possible time.

entries.sourcePattern: trong thời gian gần nhất -> stiff calque
entries.context: I hope to hear from you in the nearest time.

entries.sourcePattern: khoảng lúc 7 giờ -> double preposition
entries.context: I will call around at 7pm.

entries.sourcePattern: sớm hơn hôm qua -> double comparative pattern
entries.context: Today I woke up more early than yesterday.

entries.sourcePattern: quá trễ để đăng ký -> for/to infinitive contrast
entries.context: It is too late for register now.

entries.sourcePattern: đủ thời gian để hoàn thành -> enough + infinitive
entries.context: We have enough time for finish.

entries.sourcePattern: gần văn phòng tôi -> near usually no to in this use
entries.context: The clinic is near to my office.

entries.sourcePattern: xa nhà tôi -> far from, not far with
entries.context: The school is far with my house.

entries.sourcePattern: giống tháng trước -> same as, not same with
entries.context: The fee is same with last month.

entries.sourcePattern: khác với mẫu -> different from in this register
entries.context: The color is different with the sample.

entries.sourcePattern: tương tự như -> similar to, not similar like
entries.context: My problem is similar like your case.

entries.sourcePattern: chịu trách nhiệm về -> responsible for
entries.context: I am responsible about this task.

entries.sourcePattern: quan tâm đến việc tham gia -> interested in + gerund
entries.context: She is interested about join the class.

entries.sourcePattern: giỏi giao tiếp -> good at + gerund
entries.context: He is good in communicate with customers.

entries.sourcePattern: sợ nói tiếng Anh -> afraid of
entries.context: Many learners are afraid with speaking English.

entries.vietlish: I request you to answer today
entries.sourcePattern: yêu cầu bạn -> request sounds too forceful in routine email
entries.context: In a friendly email, I wrote: I request you to answer today.

entries.vietlish: You must send me the file
entries.natural: Could you send me the file?
entries.sourcePattern: phải gửi -> must can sound like an order to peers
entries.context: To my coworker, I wrote: You must send me the file.

entries.sourcePattern: cần bạn giải thích -> direct need-you phrasing can sound abrupt
entries.context: In chat, I typed: I need you explain now.

entries.natural: Could you handle this when you have a moment?
entries.sourcePattern: xử lý ngay -> immediately can be too sharp without context
entries.context: To support, I wrote: Please handle immediately.

entries.natural: I look forward to your feedback
entries.sourcePattern: chờ phản hồi -> wait your is abrupt and ungrammatical
entries.context: At the end of my email, I wrote: I wait your feedback.

entries.natural: Could you let me know soon?
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi câu trả lời -> give me can sound demanding
entries.context: To a teacher, I wrote: Give me your answer soon.

entries.vietlish: You are wrong about my bill
entries.natural: I think there may be an error on my bill
entries.sourcePattern: bạn sai -> direct wrong can sound confrontational
entries.context: To customer service, I wrote: You are wrong about my bill.

entries.natural: Could you explain why I was charged?
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích tại sao -> direct imperative needs softening
entries.context: In a billing email, I wrote: Explain why you charged me.

entries.natural: I would like to complain about this service
entries.sourcePattern: khiếu nại dịch vụ -> complain needs about and polite framing
entries.context: At the desk, I said: I complain this service.

entries.sourcePattern: nên sửa nhanh -> should can sound judgmental
entries.context: To the technician, I said: You should fix fast.

entries.vietlish: Because it rained so I stayed home
entries.natural: Because it rained, I stayed home
entries.sourcePattern: vì...nên -> English does not need both because and so
entries.context: Because it rained so I stayed home.

entries.vietlish: Although I was tired but I joined
entries.natural: Although I was tired, I joined
entries.sourcePattern: mặc dù...nhưng -> English does not need both although and but
entries.context: Although I was tired but I joined the call.

entries.vietlish: If you need then call me
entries.natural: If you need anything, call me
entries.sourcePattern: nếu...thì -> then often unnecessary in simple conditionals
entries.context: If you need then call me.

entries.vietlish: When I arrive then I will message you
entries.natural: When I arrive, I will message you
entries.sourcePattern: khi...thì -> then is redundant
entries.context: When I arrive then I will message you.

entries.vietlish: This problem, I already told you
entries.natural: I already told you about this problem
entries.sourcePattern: topic-first Vietnamese word order
entries.context: This problem, I already told you yesterday.

entries.vietlish: That file, you send me again
entries.natural: Could you send me that file again?
entries.sourcePattern: topic-fronting plus missing auxiliary
entries.context: That file, you send me again please.

entries.vietlish: The meeting yesterday I cannot join
entries.natural: I could not join the meeting yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese time/topic order maps poorly to English
entries.context: The meeting yesterday I cannot join.

entries.vietlish: I have one friend he lives in Calgary
entries.natural: I have a friend who lives in Calgary
entries.sourcePattern: relative clause marker omitted after một người bạn
entries.context: I have one friend he lives in Calgary.

entries.vietlish: The woman she called me is my aunt
entries.natural: The woman who called me is my aunt
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese resumptive pronoun in relative clause
entries.context: The woman she called me is my aunt.

entries.vietlish: The place we met it is near here
entries.natural: The place where we met is near here
entries.sourcePattern: resumptive it from Vietnamese clause pattern
entries.context: The place we met it is near here.

entries.vietlish: The thing I worry it is rent
entries.natural: The thing I worry about is rent
entries.sourcePattern: about + no resumptive pronoun needed
entries.context: The thing I worry it is rent.

entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese question order lacks auxiliary do
entries.context: Who you met yesterday?

entries.natural: Why did you not tell me?
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese question order lacks do-support
entries.context: Why you not tell me?

entries.natural: How long will you stay here?
entries.sourcePattern: future/modal auxiliary omitted in question
entries.context: How long you stay here?

entries.sourcePattern: be auxiliary omitted in question
entries.context: Where your office located?

entries.natural: my younger brother is very enthusiastic
entries.sourcePattern: rất nhiệt tình -> adjective form enthusiastic, needs be
entries.context: My younger brother very enthusiasm during the meeting.

entries.vietlish: the new intern has responsibility with work
entries.natural: the new intern is responsible at work
entries.sourcePattern: có trách nhiệm với công việc -> natural adjective structure
entries.context: The new intern has responsibility with work.

entries.vietlish: our landlord is sympathy with me
entries.natural: our landlord is sympathetic to me
entries.sourcePattern: thông cảm với tôi -> sympathy/sympathetic false friend
entries.context: Our landlord is sympathy with me.

entries.sourcePattern: nói chuyện tâm lý -> psychology does not mean tactful
entries.context: The nurse talks very psychology with patients.

entries.vietlish: the class monitor is easy to approach with
entries.sourcePattern: dễ gần -> adjective, no with needed
entries.context: The class monitor is easy to approach with.

entries.natural: my teammate is too rigid about rules
entries.sourcePattern: nguyên tắc quá -> principle as noun misused for rigid
entries.context: My teammate works too principle sometimes.

entries.vietlish: the delivery driver has high spirit
entries.natural: the delivery driver is highly motivated
entries.sourcePattern: có tinh thần cao -> high spirit is a calque
entries.context: The delivery driver has high spirit in the job.

entries.vietlish: the visa officer is careful in small things
entries.natural: the visa officer pays attention to details
entries.sourcePattern: cẩn thận trong từng việc nhỏ -> natural collocation differs
entries.context: The visa officer is careful in small things.

entries.vietlish: my son teacher is very dedicated
entries.natural: my son's teacher is very dedicated
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese noun sequence omits possessive marker
entries.context: My son teacher is very dedicated.

entries.natural: the repair staff is very professional
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese predicate adjective often maps without be
entries.context: The repair staff very professional.

entries.vietlish: this policy is advantaged for workers
entries.sourcePattern: có lợi cho -> advantaged is the wrong form/register
entries.context: This policy is advantaged for workers.

entries.vietlish: the plan is not convenient for our budget
entries.natural: the plan does not fit our budget
entries.sourcePattern: không tiện/không phù hợp -> convenient is overextended
entries.context: The plan is not convenient for our budget.

entries.vietlish: I am exciting about the trip
entries.natural: I am excited about the trip
entries.sourcePattern: hào hứng -> exciting/excited adjective contrast
entries.context: I am exciting about the trip.

entries.vietlish: the instruction is confused for me
entries.natural: the instruction is confusing to me
entries.sourcePattern: khó hiểu -> confused/confusing contrast
entries.context: The instruction is confused for me.

entries.sourcePattern: làm tôi hài lòng -> satisfy/satisfied pattern differs
entries.context: The result made me satisfy.

entries.sourcePattern: đủ sáng/ánh sáng -> lightness is wrong noun here
entries.context: This room has enough lightness.

entries.sourcePattern: cạnh tranh -> adjective form competitive
entries.context: The price is very competition.

entries.vietlish: the class is suitable with beginners
entries.natural: the class is suitable for beginners
entries.sourcePattern: phù hợp với -> suitable for, not suitable with
entries.context: The class is suitable with beginners.

entries.vietlish: the medicine is effective with headaches
entries.natural: the medicine is effective for headaches
entries.sourcePattern: có hiệu quả với -> effective for in this use
entries.context: The medicine is effective with headaches.

entries.vietlish: the notice is valid in thirty days
entries.natural: the notice is valid for thirty days
entries.sourcePattern: có hiệu lực trong -> valid for duration
entries.context: The notice is valid in thirty days.

entries.vietlish: I borrowed money for my friend
entries.natural: I borrowed money from my friend
entries.sourcePattern: mượn tiền của bạn -> borrow from, not for
entries.context: I borrowed money for my friend.

entries.vietlish: I lent money from my sister
entries.natural: I borrowed money from my sister
entries.sourcePattern: mượn tiền từ chị -> lend/borrow role confusion
entries.context: I lent money from my sister.

entries.sourcePattern: cho bạn mượn tiền -> borrow/lend role confusion
entries.context: I borrowed my friend money.

entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi mượn -> lend me, not borrow me
entries.context: Please borrow me your charger.

entries.sourcePattern: adverb placement follows object in natural English
entries.context: I studied by myself English last night.

entries.natural: she explained the rule to me
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích cho tôi -> explain takes thing then to person
entries.context: She explained me the rule after class.

entries.sourcePattern: đề nghị tôi -> suggest does not take object + to-infinitive
entries.context: He suggested me to wait outside.

entries.sourcePattern: thảo luận về -> discuss is transitive
entries.context: They discussed about the rent yesterday.

entries.sourcePattern: đề cập về -> mention is transitive
entries.context: We mentioned about this fee in the meeting.

entries.sourcePattern: vào phòng -> enter is transitive, no to
entries.context: She entered to the room quietly.
